Read-only IGDB catalog responses captured September 9, 2026 for SNES and Super Famicom (19, 58). These retain provider identity fields, aliases, platforms, game types, and available cover identifiers. No library choices were changed.

`snes-recovery.json` contains 68 complete search responses that the production matcher now resolves. `snes-spellings.json` contains a smaller spelling and mod-disambiguation matrix.

Sources: https://api.igdb.com/v4/games and https://api.igdb.com/v4/game_types. These fixtures preserve the regression cases independently of the original local audit.
